violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwashers (in kitchen and at bar) were 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Chemical dispensing line was observed in improper chemicals. Lines were flushed and correct chemical was placed. Dish machine at bar was reading correct concentration. Service to be called for dish machine in kitchen. All dishes in the kitchen to be washed, rinsed and sanitized in 3 bay sink until dish machine is properly adjusted. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026
The following were observed in poor repair: 1. prep unit gaskets 2. 2 door reach-in gaskets 3. walk-in cooler gaskets New Violation. Correct By: 09/14/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the shelving in the walk-in cooler have an accumulation of dust, dirt and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026

The condensate from the refrigeration unit is draining into a non-functional evaporator pan. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain or other approved method. New Violation. Correct By: 07/28/2026
The drain cover by the mop sink was observed missing. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/14/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the storage unit. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 08/14/2026
The floors in the walk-in cooler area are in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 10/14/2026
